name: tense
character: tense / dark / suspense: drones, ostinati and unresolved harmony are the point, so they are not defects

pattern.loop_short.reason: ostinati and drones repeat on purpose; only a 1-2 bar exact loop is flagged

pattern.flags_max.reason: a sparse cue has fewer varied parts, so more flags are normal before it reads as a loop

roughness.reason: dissonance is wanted, and a tense cue need not resolve at the end

chroma.concordance.reason: clashing beds against the key are part of the colour
